steps: EMERGENCY - call vascular surgery immediately; do NOT delay for extensive imaging if unstable.
Permissive hypotension (avoid aggressive fluids/overshoot before repair); large-bore access, major haemorrhage protocol.
Immediate transfer to theatre / endovascular suite for repair (EVAR or open).
CT angiography only if stable enough.

confirm: Sudden abdominal/back/flank pain with hypotension and a pulsatile mass in an older patient - ruptured AAA until proven otherwise.

investigations.test: Bedside US / CT angio if stable
